channel.title: Wire — JavaScript
channel.description: JavaScript from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: tinyjs: Build JavaScript Desktop Apps in <10MB
item.description: Build macOS, Windows, and Linux desktop apps in JavaScript: txiki.js backend, native WebKit / WebView2 / WebKitGTK window, ~6 MB shipped. No Electron. No ports. (1 source: javascriptweekly)

item.title: Origin Private File System
item.description: The origin private file system (OPFS) is a storage endpoint provided as part of the File System API, which is private to the origin of the page and not visible to the user like the regular file system. (1 source: javascriptweekly)

item.title: How Notion handles concurrent editing with CRDTs
item.description: Building a CRDT-based rich-text system that merges concurrent edits across Notion blocks—without losing anyone’s work (2 sources: javascriptweekly, lobsters)

item.title: Persistent Databases in the Browser with DuckDB-Wasm and OPFS
item.description: DuckDB-Wasm can open a persistent database file in the browser's Origin Private File System (OPFS). This post shows how, and when data reaches disk. (2 sources: javascriptweekly, lobsters)

item.title: OJ: A Rust-Native, Vite-Compatible Dev Server
item.description: Lovable previews are moving to OJ, a Rust-native dev server that starts them several times faster on a fraction of the memory. We are rolling it out gradually, and today OJ is open source in the Lovable GitHub organization. (2 sources: javascriptweekly, reactstatus)

item.title: @shadcn/lint: An Agent-First Linter for Tailwind Design Systems
item.description: An agent-first linter for Tailwind design systems. Write design system rules that agents can verify. - shadcn-ui/lint (2 sources: javascriptweekly, reactstatus)

item.title: How Linear Reworked Its CI for 4x the Tests
item.description: We cut PR wait time and running costs by rethinking CI as a system, from the infrastructure underneath it to how work gets scheduled and tests get parallelized. (1 source: javascriptweekly)

item.title: disputes the benchmark
item.description: Lovable’s OJ rewrites Vite’s dev server in Rust, reducing memory use and preview times as AI lowers the cost of open source reimplementation. (1 source: javascriptweekly)

item.title: Node.js 26.10.0 (Current)
item.description: Node.js® is a free, open-source, cross-platform JavaScript runtime environment that lets developers create servers, web apps, command line tools and scripts. (1 source: javascriptweekly)

item.title: An Undercover Analyst Infiltrated the Gang Behind 'Mini Shai-Hulud'
item.description: TeamPCP pulled off the worst-ever software supply-chain hacking spree and breached thousands of companies. Now Google’s threat intelligence group says it had a mole inside the hackers’ inner circle. (1 source: javascriptweekly)
